propositions: inspect-ai is never imported in src/rebar; the only reference is the _optional.EXTRAS registry name string
The [eval] extra and inspect-ai dependency create two [tool.uv] conflicts entries (eval vs bedrock, eval vs dev) that block co-installation of dev and bedrock
The click>=8.3.3 override exists solely to work around inspect-ai's stale click < 8.2.2 cap, holding the project on vulnerable click 8.2.1 and failing CI pip-audit gates
No pytest test gated on [eval] can run because the eval/dev conflict prevents both from installing in the same environment
The module docstring in eval.py falsely claims Inspect AI integration twice, contradicted by the implementation which explicitly states NOT routed through Inspect AI
Removing inspect-ai, the [eval] extra, both conflicts entries, and the click override dissolves machinery that exists only to accommodate an unused dependency
